1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 30 m de altura, de hojas paripinnadas, inflorescencia panicular, flores blanco verdosas y fruto capsular; su madera se utiliza en carpintería y ebanistería. Meliaceae; Cedrela tubiflora.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 30 m, with paripinnate leaves, paniculate inflorescence, white-greenish flowers and capsular fruit; its wood is used in carpentry and cabinetmaking. Meliaceae; Cedrela tubiflora.
